triggerReasons.message: Request has a structural multi-deliverable signal, so milestone coverage must be countable.
A milestone ledger exists, so every ledger row needs checklist and verificationIntent coverage.
High-risk or gate/security wording selects high-assurance intent hardening.
High-assurance work requires an independent intent-collision result.
Ambiguity, user impact, behavior change, or multi-deliverable intent makes intent collision diagnostically required.
Broad or absolute scope wording should have scope clarification before future enforcement.

acceptanceBindings.acceptanceClaim: All seven milestone ledger rows are either delivered with evidence, assigned to explicit child stories through an accepted slice plan, or marked not_applicable only through an explicit user-approved scope-shrinkage decision; final ProofStory gate, intent coverage, review completeness, and DONE intent equivalence all pass.
acceptanceBindings.note: Parent ProofStory contract binds all seven user-approved milestones to checklist and verification intent refs. Child slicing is allowed only through an explicit slice plan; shrinkage requires user-approved scope-shrinkage decision.

diagnosticGaps.message: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured.

Milestone ledger has 7 row(s), above the 5 row threshold for high_assurance. Record a complete slice-plan.json or assignedStory fields before enforce-mode DEV admission; suggested slicing groups are diagnostic only and no child stories are created automatically.
